subject: U-442 split landed on u-442 (3 commits); AC-3 partial, base suite red
body: Split verify.py's two roots behind --git-dir (SHA/git legs, via git -C) and --evidence-root (what bounds manifest-relative evidence paths), test-first: branch u-442 = 4ad601a1 (RED fixture: two scratch repos, A holds manifest+evidence, B holds the SHAs) -> 1ef8bd79 (fix) -> df4f524f (evidence bundle); with both flags absent every resolution is byte-identical (_ROOTS stays {None,None}), and --evidence-root is deliberately NOT implied by --git-dir. #267 is re-rooted, not relaxed: absolute and escaping paths stay REFUSED against the named root, the root itself must be inside a git work tree (a bad root is exit 1 usage, not exit 2 verdict), and cross-repo evidence passes only on its artifacts[] sha256 pin; negative control EXECUTED (verify.py restored from base in a throwaway worktree at head_sha, test kept) -> exit 1 with 8 ASSERTION failures, clean head_sha -> exit 0, and the verifier's own commands ledger reads FRESH (3 exit-0 records bound to head_sha tree 9d5293f1). TWO THINGS FOR YOU: AC-3 is PARTIAL not met -- validate.py exits 0 but the full suite exits 1 on 5 failures that ALL reproduce at base_sha a58bf71a (4x test_docs_navigation incl. the run-archive index not linking docs/runs/2026-09-20-clean-sweep-tracker.md that your own base commits added, 1x test_wire_docs README fixed point), out of this unit's frozen scope so reported not fixed; and the frozen spec build-u442.md writes its acceptance criteria as unlabeled '- [ ]' checkboxes, so check_scope extracts no criterion ids and fails closed -- as frozen it cannot serve as the authoritative --contract-source, which blocks the independent verification until it is re-frozen with labeled ids. No PR opened per the spec; worktree clean; interface-width pin raised 85->88 with the budget named in its docstring (ratchet width<92 intact).
